story.iWant: TypeScript types and API client generated from the Control Sequence API OpenAPI spec
story.soThat: the Designer can consume the API with full type safety and auto-completion

tasks.task: Create control-sequence domain folder structure - Create apps/designer/src/domains/control-sequence/ directory - Create subdirectories: api/, api/types/, api/queries/, api/mutations/ - Create types.ts for domain-specific types - Create index.ts as domain public API (follow building-semantics pattern)

Configure openapi-ts generation script - Add generate:control-sequence-client script to apps/designer/package.json - Configure to read from http://localhost:8001/openapi.json - Configure output directory as ./src/domains/control-sequence/api/generated - Set client to @hey-api/client-fetch - Add sed command to replace baseUrl with /control-sequence (nginx proxy route)

Generate TypeScript client - Ensure Control Sequence API is running locally on port 8001 - Run pnpm generate:control-sequence-client from designer directory - Verify generated folder structure matches building-semantics pattern

Create API config and exports - Create api/config.ts with client configuration - Create api/index.ts to export queries/mutations - Create api/types/index.ts for custom type extensions - Set baseUrl from environment variable or default to /control-sequence
Create domain index.ts with public exports - Export generated types from api/generated/types.gen - Export client configuration - Follow building-semantics/index.ts pattern for module organization

Verify type alignment with Pydantic DTOs - Verify ReheatParameters type matches Python DTO fields - Verify ReheatInputsRequest type matches Python DTO fields - Verify ReheatOutputs type matches Python DTO fields - Verify StepRequest and StepResponse types match Python DTOs - Verify ErrorResponse type matches Python DTO

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Add generate:control-sequence-client script to Designer package.json
Uses openapi-ts to generate from Control Sequence API's /openapi.json

Client configured with correct baseUrl for nginx proxy route (/control-sequence)

doc.title: Control Sequence API Technical Specification
doc.snippet: Pattern same as building-semantics-api-app: Define Pydantic DTOs → FastAPI generates OpenAPI → Run openapi-ts → Designer imports generated types. Designer package.json script: "generate:g36-client": "openapi-ts --input http://localhost:8001/openapi.json --output ./src/domains/g36/api/generated --client @hey-api/client-fetch"

doc.title: Story 1.16: API Documentation
doc.snippet: All endpoints have docstrings, field descriptions, and examples. 421 tests passing. DTOs already have comprehensive Field(description=..., json_schema_extra=...) which will generate good TypeScript JSDoc.

doc.title: Project Development Guidelines
doc.snippet: Next.js 15.5 with Turbopack, TypeScript with strict type checking, @xyflow/react for visual programming, Zustand for state management, Jest + React Testing Library for testing.

python.purpose: DTO definitions with Field metadata that becomes TypeScript types

constraints.constraint: Follow same pattern as building-semantics-api-app for OpenAPI generation
Generated types should be used directly as node data model - NO manual redefinition
Control Sequence API exposed at /control-sequence via nginx proxy (configured in Story 1.7)
No comments unless explaining WHY. Method/variable names should be self-documenting.
Follow building-semantics domain folder structure exactly
Domain index.ts is the ONLY file external modules should import from

tests.standards: Designer uses Jest with React Testing Library. Unit tests colocated with source files as .spec.ts. Integration tests in tests/ folder. Mock external dependencies. Follow TDD: write test first, then implement.

ideas.idea: Test that package.json script exists and has correct parameters (input URL, output path, client)
Test that generated folder contains expected files: types.gen.ts, sdk.gen.ts, client.gen.ts
Test that generated ReheatParameters interface has expected fields (minAirflow, maxCoolingAirflow, etc.)
Test that generated ReheatInputsRequest interface has expected fields (zoneTemperature, coolingSetpoint, etc.)
Test that generated ReheatOutputs interface has expected fields (damperPosition, valvePosition, airflowSetpoint)
Test that config.ts sets baseUrl correctly using environment variable fallback
Test that client.gen.ts baseUrl is /control-sequence (nginx proxy path)
